name: Salt River (Upper Salt / Salt River Canyon Wilderness)
blurb: Multi-day Class III-IV wilderness whitewater from the US-60 bridge to the AZ-288 bridge. Tonto NF boater permit (lottery) Mar 1-May 15; White Mountain Apache Tribe permit for the first ~29 miles.

sections.notes: Technical Class III–IV wilderness whitewater; some rapids approach Class V at low water. First Campground is on Apache Road 1 below US 60, river right. The Highway 288 takeout is just downstream of the bridge on river left, 52.3 miles downstream. Tonto wilderness permits are required March 1–May 15; separate tribal rafting permits apply to the reservation reach. Check current permits and access restrictions before planning a trip.
sections.accessReview: Tribal access closure needs clarification: WMAT posted a Salt River access-area and Cibecue Falls closure on October 27, 2026. Confirm reopening and whether First Campground launches and through-trips are permitted before planning this stretch.

notices.title: Tribal access closure reported
notices.text: WMAT’s October 27 notice says the Salt River access area and Cibecue Falls remain closed because of flash-flood risks. It does not define the full rafting or launch boundary. Confirm current access with WMAT Game & Fish at 928-338-4385; an older page saying closures were lifted is not a reopening confirmation.
notices.sourceName: White Mountain Apache Tribe Game & Fish — October 27, 2026 public notice

notices.title: Separate river permits
notices.text: The Tonto wilderness permit season is March 1–May 15. Use Recreation.gov for current lottery dates and fees. WMAT also requires individual rafting permits, including a two-day permit for trips beyond Hoodoo; review current tribal rules and closures before applying.
notices.sourceName: Recreation.gov — Salt River Canyon Wilderness Permit

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
